_note: Recurring cast of Movies English (Reel English). build.py copies `identity`, `wardrobe` and `voice` verbatim into every still and shot prompt so faces never drift by retyping. Faces are original designs (references in ../american-everyday-stories/references/faces.md rules: one shape, one dominant feature, one or two sided details, never a scar or mark through a brow, never 'looks like'). Three pairs, each with its own comic engine; any character may cross into another pair's story. `letter` = speaker letter in cues/speakers.txt; never W or M.
